senses.gloss: f. (גרב, גרף, labial softened) [a quantity carried at a time to and from the hand-mill (cmp. I גָּרָב 1),] 1) griva, a dry measure (= סְאָה).
units: Ab. Zar. 43ᵃ והוא דנקיט ג׳ וכ׳ provided the statue (of Serapis) has a grivah (modius) as a symbol of measuring (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Coma).
<cite ref="Eruvin 29b:9">Erub. 29ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="C01297"><he>גרויא</he></cite> (corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1).
<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:1">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ג׳ וכ׳</he> whatever measure I may want.

senses.gloss: בי ג׳ or ג׳ the size of a field needed for a griva of seed (cmp. סְאָה).
units: B. Kam. 96ᵃ ג׳ דארעא a griva of land; B. Mets. 110ᵇ; ib. 15ᵇ גרבא ed. (Ms. M. גרויא, Ms. F. גריבא, Ms. R. גריוא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—Pl. גְּרִיוֵי.
